title: Android XML Switch sizing and spacing
purpose: Check that Android XML switchMinWidth, switchPadding and thumbTextPadding change switch geometry while toggling remains usable in both layout directions.
changes: Added XML control of the minimum track width, the gap beside the label, and padding around on/off thumb text, including wrap-content measurement and thumb travel for wider tracks.
steps: At Android XML switch sizing and spacing, check that Wide track has a noticeably wider track and a gap after its label. Toggle it several times: the thumb should travel between the ends.
Check State text: the on/off text should fit in the wider thumb. Toggle it between NO and YES. Check that Wrap is a compact switch rather than filling the whole row.

Turn on Right-to-left layout near the top and repeat. The tracks should move to the left of their labels, with thumb motion reversed. Choose OK if it works; otherwise choose Reject and describe the failing step, what happened and your device.
expected: The configured sizes and gaps are visible, state text fits, wrap content remains compact, and switches toggle in both directions.
limits: Bhoo keeps a minimum 52 dp track and a fixed 9 sp state text style. Android theme defaults, custom drawables, optical insets and exact Android device appearance and animation have not been verified.

references.scope: Switch sizing, thumb text padding and label spacing.

validation: 159 Android XML importer tests passed, including sizing validation.
Six Rust switch tests passed, including spacing and right-to-left geometry.
Full libbhoo Rust test suite passed after correcting wrap-content track measurement.
A 320 × 500 browser check verified visibility, all three toggles, wrap width and RTL placement.
